Linear ODE: y and its derivatives appear only to the first power, not multiplied together or inside functions; y′ + p(t)y = g(t) has a unique solution on the largest open interval containing t₀ where p and g are continuous; aₙy⁽ⁿ⁾ + … = δ(t) ⇒ y⁽ⁿ⁻¹⁾ jumps by 1/aₙ at t = 0
coefficients depend on t (t² y″ + 7t y′ + 8t y = 10 sin t) → linear, time varying; constant coefficients → linear time invariant (LTI)

Real distinct m1, m2: y = c1em1x + c2em2x; Equal m: y = (c1 + c2x)emx; α ± iβ: y = eαx(c1cos βx + c2sin βx)
